title: Casa Manana and going to California for Cabin in the Sky
summary: Bubbles says they played Billy Rose's Casa Manana six weeks before doing Cabin in the Sky in 1941.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: You also did "Cabin in the Sky." Was that done in that period?
That was done in '41.
"Cabin in the Sky."
Yeah, I did the picture in California in '41.
What other pictures were you in other than --
Now, wait. You got "Cabin in the Sky." Don't rid Nazarro until you get that outof the way because he put us in "Cabin in the Sky." That's in '41, ain't it?
That was the next film after "Varsity Show."
That's right.
How did that all come about?
Which?
"Cabin in the Sky."
Wasn't that a stage play?
It was a movie.
Oh, I played Billy Rose's "Casa Mañana." We played "Casa Mañana" just before we went to do "Cabin in the Sky." And we had to do that at the MGM studio, I think it was.
That was another film.
Yeah, that's a film, "Cabin in the Sky."
No, "Casa Mañana."
No this is a cabaret for Billy Rose. He had the "Casa
Mañana" restaurant. We played there for him for about six weeks. Then we went to the coast to do "Cabin in the Sky." I think we did it in 1941.
Who was directing that picture?
Howard Hawks, I think it was.* I think he just died not so long ago, too.
